name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
summary: An epic boon that lets you teleport 30 feet after the Attack or Magic action.

benefits.name: Ability Score Increase
benefits.text: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

benefits.name: Blink Steps
benefits.text: Immediately after you take the {ref:glossary/attack} action or the {ref:glossary/magic} action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
